attributes.corpus_control: A project-wide screen (all 323 units, our objects vs target objects) found 23 byte-EXACT functions that DO emit the wanted `add rD,rA,rB` + `addi rD,rD,K` in-place form. The closest analogue, ui/attract.c::init_screen2d (`add r29,r31,r30` / `addi r29,r29,232`), gets it from `so = slot*320; p = base + so; p += 232;` where `so` is a `register`-declared variable with a SECOND use later AND the function is compiled under `#pragma opt_propagation off` + `#pragma opt_common_subs off`. Reproducing the variable half alone (named local, then `register` local) did not reproduce the register choice, and cam_orient_to has no natural second use of the multiply to keep it alive.

attributes.measurements: baseline and best both real 4, insns 102/102, --ops multiset IDENTICAL (pure recolor). Neutral (byte-identical) probes: (1) single-expression init `gcs + camIdx*396 + 0xC8`; (2) named `s32 camOff` staging local; (3) `register s32 camOff`; (4) scoped `#pragma opt_propagation off`; (5) array-index address form `&((Camera*)gcs)[camIdx]` (also confirms sizeof(Camera)==396); (6) operand-order swap `camIdx*396 + gcs`. Negative: scoped `#pragma peephole off` regressed real 4 -> 20 (entry schedule scrambled), which independently CONFIRMS peephole-ON is the correct setting for this TU.
attributes.residual: REGISTER_ONLY, exactly 2 instructions at function +0x1C/+0x20. target `add r31,r5,r4` + `addi r31,r31,200`; ours `add r4,r5,r4` + `addi r31,r4,200`. Same opcodes, same order, same operand pair, same final value in r31. The ONLY difference is which register carries the intermediate `gCameraState + camIdx*396`: target colours it into `cam`'s callee-saved home r31 (one web, bumped in place), ours coalesces it with the dying mulli operand r4 (two webs). MECHANISM NAMED: MWCC's allocator is free to merge the one-instruction-lived temp either with the dead source operand or with the destination variable; both are legal colourings of an identical interference graph, and no source spelling reaches the choice because every spelling folds to the same IR.

attributes.webfrank_ready: WEBFRANK-READY, REGISTER_ONLY. The two streams are related by a single renaming of one intermediate register with no other change, and the renaming is soundness-checkable without a dataflow model: r4 is a volatile caller-save scratch that is DEAD in both streams from +0x20 until it is unconditionally redefined at +0xF0 (`addi r4,r31,164`), and there is no call, branch target, or read of r4 in between. Same-shape residual recorded on the sibling function init_game_cam (attempt.initgamecam-u64-buttons-dance.20260830.v1, 'prologue add-destination pick'), and visible in DiffRate_8002951C and get_cam_wpos_8002ABE0, so one sound rule for this form would pay across at least four functions in this TU.
